review_kind: Source review and independent integer-oracle validation, separate from implementation; not an external human or security audit
scope: Negative-stride normalization and adjacent/singleton dimension coalescing, retaining the arbitrary-layout rank-at-most-four guard

code_review.negative_stride_mapping: For a nonempty dimension, shifting the base by (size-1)*negative_stride and replacing the stride by its magnitude reverses that dimension's index order bijectively. Singleton dimensions contribute zero base shift, including INT_MIN strides.
code_review.coalescing_mapping: An adjacent pair with outer_stride == inner_size*inner_stride has the same address multiset as one dimension with the product size and inner stride. An outer singleton can be discarded; an inner singleton retains the outer stride. The implementation moves the product size inward and sets the discarded outer size to one, supporting forward repeated collapse.
code_review.logical_multiplicity: Zero and overlapping strides remain repeated logical elements. Zero-by-zero contiguous merging changes the iteration shape but not the number of additions.
code_review.empty_arrays: Zero dimension products remain zero through merging. Forced arbitrary-layout empty views with extreme irrelevant strides completed without loads or incorrect nonzero results in the independent probe.
code_review.scope_preserved: The compile-time rank/layout gate is unchanged. Floating-point and complex accumulators, bool outputs, explicit axes, and arbitrary-layout arrays above rank four retain the original path. Integer casts and wrapping addition remain unchanged.

reproduction.oracle: Python-integer sum of logical elements modulo the output width, with signed decoding where applicable; no import or reuse of the optimized iterator or coalescing implementation
reproduction.bounds: Random rank-four views allocate buffers covering their full minimum-to-maximum byte offset; no out-of-bounds as_strided views are used.
reproduction.input_preservation: Every seeded, RGB, gap/overlap and boolean-byte input is compared against its pre-call copy.

validation.timing_note: Correctness diagnostic duration under concurrent repository tests, not a performance benchmark

unsuccessful_setup_attempts.cause: The first standalone-script invocation omitted PYTHONPATH and imported system Numba from /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages instead of the reviewed source.
unsuccessful_setup_attempts.interpretation: System Numba/selected llvmlite incompatibility before the intended source was tested; not a result mismatch in the coalesced implementation.
unsuccessful_setup_attempts.resolution: Reran with explicit PYTHONPATH selecting the reviewed checkout; all 640 cases passed and the imported source path was recorded.

changes_by_reviewer: Only the reproducible research probe and this JSON artifact; no production source or unit-test edits.
